lessons.title: Lesson 10: Files, Exceptions, Environments, and Tests (Part 1)
lessons.objective: Read and write files with explicit encodings, anchored paths, and guaranteed resource cleanup; diagnose missing files and invalid content from evidence.

lessons.title: Lesson 11: Files, Exceptions, Environments, and Tests (Part 2)
lessons.objective: Handle expected failures with precise exception types and isolated virtual environments; diagnose tracebacks and wrong-environment faults with evidence.

lessons.title: Lesson 12: Files, Exceptions, Environments, and Tests (Part 3)
lessons.objective: Write unittest assertions over disposable file fixtures and triage a failing test as a code bug, a test bug, or an environment fault to make programs repeatable.

lessons.title: Lesson 13: Text Project and Git Collaboration (Part 1)
lessons.objective: Run, implement, and debug the actual text_tools project: exercise every CLI flag, independently re-implement a statistics or split function, pass held-out behavior checks (missing input, malformed UTF-8, empty input, invalid ratios, seed determinism), and write a project report stating assumptions and limits.

lessons.title: Lesson 14: Consolidation & Assessment Review
lessons.objective: Practice Git collaboration safely in disposable repositories: focused branches and diffs, independent merge-conflict resolution, safe recovery with restore/revert (never reset --hard, clean, or force-push on the learning tree), and PR-style review separating correctness, scope, tests, risks, and evidence.

lessons.title: Lesson 15: Text Project and Git Collaboration (Part 3)
lessons.objective: Reproduce the complete text_tools pipeline from a clean environment, independently evaluate held-out cases (Unicode, empty input, malformed encoding, duplicate records, ratio validation, reproducibility), trace the provenance chain from source hash through seed to split hashes for later model reuse, and deliver an honest PR-style portfolio handoff.

lessons.title: Lesson 16: Functions, Limits, and Derivatives (Part 1)
lessons.objective: Represent functions, calculate average slopes, and reason about limits from nearby values with explicit domains and assumptions.

lessons.title: Lesson 17: Functions, Limits, and Derivatives (Part 2)
lessons.objective: Derive derivatives from the limit definition, apply rules with stated assumptions, and explain the absolute-value nondifferentiable counterexample.

lessons.title: Lesson 18: Functions, Limits, and Derivatives (Part 3)
lessons.objective: Use finite differences to verify derivatives and explain truncation error, cancellation, floating-point effects, and why the smallest step is not always best.

lessons.title: Lesson 19: Chain Rule and Multivariable Gradients (Part 1)
lessons.objective: Derive and apply the scalar chain rule on composed functions, verify each result by expansion or finite difference, and explain where differentiability fails.

lessons.title: Lesson 20: Chain Rule and Multivariable Gradients (Part 2)
lessons.objective: Compute partial derivatives, assemble and interpret the gradient vector, and prove that shared dependency paths add contributions in the multivariable chain rule.

lessons.title: Lesson 21: Consolidation & Assessment Review
lessons.objective: Walk a scalar computational graph forward and backward by hand, show that shared nodes accumulate gradient contributions like an autograd engine, and re-verify the block with a finite-difference harness.

lessons.title: Lesson 22: Linear Algebra and Tensor Reasoning (Part 1)
lessons.objective: Mastery of vectors, linear combinations, dot products, and matrices as linear maps, including matrix-vector products with explicit shape accounting, under verified criteria.

lessons.title: Lesson 23: Linear Algebra and Tensor Reasoning (Part 2)
lessons.objective: Mastery of matrix multiplication as composed linear maps with explicit (m x k)(k x n) -> m x n shape ledgers, plus transpose, identity, and inverse intuition, under verified criteria.

lessons.title: Lesson 24: Linear Algebra and Tensor Reasoning (Part 3)
lessons.objective: Mastery of tensors with named batch/time/channel axes, broadcasting rules and failure diagnosis, reshape and view-versus-copy behavior, and memory ledgers for model operations, under verified criteria.

lessons.title: Lesson 25: Probability, Sampling, and Information (Part 1)
lessons.objective: Compute event, conditional, and posterior probabilities by counting and Bayes' rule; state the assumed probability model; distinguish empirical frequencies from guaranteed probabilities.

lessons.title: Lesson 26: Probability, Sampling, and Information (Part 2)
lessons.objective: Define discrete random variables and distributions; compute expectation and variance; draw and interpret seeded samples; derive maximum-likelihood estimates including the zero-count failure.

lessons.title: Lesson 27: Probability, Sampling, and Information (Part 3)
lessons.objective: Measure surprisal in bits and nats; compute entropy, cross-entropy, and KL divergence; connect cross-entropy to language-model negative log-likelihood and perplexity with numerical-stability safeguards.

lessons.title: Lesson 28: Consolidation & Assessment Review
lessons.objective: Compute honest descriptive statistics and sampling standard errors, and distinguish a statistical claim from a toy observation under verified mastery criteria.

lessons.title: Lesson 29: Statistics, Evaluation, and Optimization (Part 2)
lessons.objective: Design train/validation/test evaluation protocols that exclude data leakage, compare against honest baselines, and interpret accuracy, loss, and perplexity under distribution shift.

lessons.title: Lesson 30: Statistics, Evaluation, and Optimization (Part 3)
lessons.objective: Derive gradient-descent updates, classify learning-rate regimes including divergence and saddle points, and produce honest failure analyses under verified mastery criteria.

lessons.title: Lesson 31: Independently Implement Automatic Differentiation (Part 1)
lessons.objective: Mastery of core concepts in Independently Implement Automatic Differentiation under verified criteria.

lessons.title: Lesson 32: Independently Implement Automatic Differentiation (Part 2)

lessons.title: Lesson 34: MLPs and Backpropagation (Part 1)
lessons.objective: Construct feedforward MLPs, layer composition, and hand-computed forward passes.

lessons.title: Lesson 35: Consolidation & Assessment Review
lessons.objective: Derive backpropagation by hand, error terms, and analyze gradient flow.

lessons.title: Lesson 36: MLPs and Backpropagation (Part 3)
lessons.objective: Implement the full training loop, explore learning rates, and diagnose failure modes.

lessons.title: Lesson 37: Text Modeling and Tokenization (Part 1)
lessons.objective: Map characters to UTF-8 bytes and integer token IDs, establish vocabularies and round-trip encode/decode invariants, and separate train splits from evaluation splits without leakage.

lessons.title: Lesson 38: Text Modeling and Tokenization (Part 2)
lessons.objective: Estimate character bigram count matrices and maximum-likelihood transition probabilities, apply Laplace and add-k smoothing, evaluate held-out log-likelihood and perplexity, and contrast with naive sampling.

lessons.title: Lesson 39: Text Modeling and Tokenization (Part 3)
lessons.objective: Implement byte-pair encoding (BPE) pair frequency counting and iterative merges, handle unicode code points and special tokens, compare teaching tokenizers with production BPE tokenizers, and verify lossless round-trip decoding.

lessons.title: Lesson 40: Embeddings and Neural Language Models (Part 1)
lessons.objective: Mastery of embedding lookup tables as learned features, one-hot equivalence, distributed representations, context concatenation, and parameter ledgers under verified criteria.

lessons.title: Lesson 41: Embeddings and Neural Language Models (Part 2)
lessons.objective: Mastery of the Makemore-style neural language model forward pass: hidden tanh layer, logits, and numerically stable softmax under verified criteria.

lessons.title: Lesson 42: Consolidation & Assessment Review
lessons.objective: Mastery of cross-entropy/NLL loss, disciplined training-loop observation with fixed splits and seeds, overfitting and instability counterexamples, and honest baseline comparison under verified criteria.

lessons.title: Lesson 43: Attention and Causal Constraints (Part 1)
lessons.objective: Mastery of scaled dot-product attention, query/key/value matrix formulation, variance derivation of inner products in R^{d_k}, and scaling factor 1/sqrt(d_k) to prevent softmax saturation under verified criteria.

lessons.title: Lesson 44: Attention and Causal Constraints (Part 2)
lessons.objective: Mastery of autoregressive causal masking, lower-triangular mask construction, max-shifted softmax with -inf entries, and strict empirical and analytical verification of past-token invariance under future perturbations under verified criteria.

lessons.title: Lesson 45: Attention and Causal Constraints (Part 3)
lessons.objective: Mastery of multi-head attention mechanics, linear projections W^Q, W^K, W^V, W^O, batched tensor reshaping (B, h, T, d_k), exact parameter ledgers, and edge-case numerical stability under verified criteria.

lessons.title: Lesson 46: Assemble and Explain a Transformer (Part 1)
lessons.objective: Assemble Transformer blocks with LayerNorm, RMSNorm, and residual connections.

lessons.title: Lesson 47: Assemble and Explain a Transformer (Part 2)
lessons.objective: Construct position-wise FFN layers, analyze expansion ratios, and stack modular blocks.

lessons.title: Lesson 48: Assemble and Explain a Transformer (Part 3)
lessons.objective: Trace end-to-end token-to-logit forward pass, explain weight tying, and pass comprehensive mastery check.

lessons.title: Lesson 49: Week 7 Consolidation and the Pretraining Data Pipeline
lessons.objective: Consolidate Days 43-48 (attention through logits) and build autoregressive (x, y) batches for the pretraining loop.

lessons.title: Lesson 50: Run the Pretraining Loop (Part 2)
lessons.objective: Implement AdamW decoupled weight decay, separate 2D/1D parameter groups, and build warmup-cosine schedules.

lessons.title: Lesson 51: Run the Pretraining Loop (Part 3)
lessons.objective: Execute the complete pretraining loop, track train/eval loss, save checkpoints, and diagnose failure modes.

lessons.title: Lesson 52: Generation, Overfitting, and Evaluation (Part 1)
lessons.objective: Implement autoregressive text generation, temperature scaling, Top-k, and Nucleus (Top-p) sampling.

lessons.title: Lesson 53: Generation, Overfitting, and Evaluation (Part 2)
lessons.objective: Track validation loss gap, compute held-out perplexity, and diagnose data leakage.

lessons.title: Lesson 54: Generation, Overfitting, and Evaluation (Part 3)
lessons.objective: Analyze qualitative degeneration failure modes, small model boundaries, and pass comprehensive mastery exam.

lessons.title: Lesson 55: Checkpoint Serialization & Safe Resumption
lessons.objective: Serialize model weights, optimizer states, learning rate schedules, and RNG seeds atomically with verified resume loss equivalence.

lessons.title: Lesson 56: Week 8 Consolidation and Resource Planning
lessons.objective: Consolidate Days 50-55 (optimizer, training loop, sampling, evaluation, checkpoints) and plan parameters, memory, and compute for a pretraining run.

lessons.title: Lesson 57: Fault Tolerance, Corruption Recovery & Billing Safeguards
lessons.objective: Diagnose truncated checkpoints, perform partial weight transfers, handle SIGTERM Spot preemption signals, and defend research budgets.

lessons.title: Lesson 58: Preflight Planning & Cost Ceilings
lessons.objective: Audit cloud GPU capabilities, enforce strict spending ceilings ($10-$20 max), and execute zero-cost local dry runs.

lessons.title: Lesson 59: Unattended Cloud Execution & Telemetry Dynamics
lessons.objective: Launch persistent detached training via Tmux, stream loss and gradient norms, and calculate real-time MFU without idle study billing.

lessons.title: Lesson 60: Post-Mortem Audit, Safetensors & Teardown
lessons.objective: Audit validation perplexity, reconcile full cloud spending down to the penny, export Safetensors, and execute physical cloud teardown.

lessons.title: Lesson 61: Instruction Data Formats, Schemas & Token Boundary Alignment
lessons.objective: Master Alpaca, ChatML, and ShareGPT schemas, multi-turn conversation formatting, and token boundary alignment to eliminate prompt injection and delimiter truncation bugs.

lessons.title: Lesson 62: Loss Masking & Target Label Construction
lessons.objective: Implement causal autoregressive next-token shifting, apply ignore_index = -100 to prompt and padding tokens, and verify that cross-entropy loss gradients compute exclusively on assistant response tokens.

lessons.title: Lesson 63: Week 9 Consolidation and Benchmark Decontamination
lessons.objective: Consolidate Days 57-62 (fault tolerance, budgets, telemetry, teardown, instruction formats, label masking) and audit SFT data against benchmark contamination.

lessons.title: Lesson 66: Adapter Merging & Zero-Latency Serving
